title: Baby Shower
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael hosts a baby shower for Jan's newborn, Astrid, featuring humorous and awkward moments including Dwight's simulated labor and stroller safety tests. Michael struggles with his feelings about the baby and his relationship with Jan, while coworkers engage in various baby-related antics and games. The episode also explores Michael's budding relationship with Holly and the office's mixed reactions to Jan's presence and behavior.
